crossRefs.note: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may…
Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses…
Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through…
The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the…
Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu…
“Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister…
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people…
Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set…
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan…
Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city…
The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

translations.web: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
translations.kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
translations.asv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Jehovah, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off:
